title: Eight eMudhra CA Keys Compromised, Triggering Emergency Fixes Across Browsers and Software
summary:
The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate certificate authority (CA) certificates are compromised, Mozilla and Google's Chrome Root Program confirms on October 20.

An intermediate CA signs the certificates that websites present, so anyone holding one of these keys could issue a certificate for any website that a browser would accept.

title: Hackers Use Autonomous AI Agents to Breach Company Websites, Target Over 1,200 Sites
summary:

title: Go Issues Emergency Update Blocking Eight CA Keys Over Undisclosed Security Concerns
summary:

title: Hackers Hijack Five OVHcloud CLI Releases to Distribute Secret-Stealing Malware
summary:
An attacker used a contributor's GitHub account to replace the download archives on five existing releases of OVHcloud's command-line tool on Monday, October 19. The account had been hijacked, and the new files were a build designed to steal secrets stored on the disk of any machine that runs it, the cloud provider says.
